title: FAI Policy Overlay Schema v1
description: Company-owned policy that filters every emit from Stage S6 (compose-infra) + every customize entry-point. Declares allow-listed regions, models, SKUs, naming/tags rules, network posture, RBAC posture, identity providers, IaC format, encryption defaults, observability defaults, and cost guardrails. Loaded as YAML at runtime but specified here in JSON Schema 2020-12 (Ajv-compatible). Reproduce-bit: same RepoFacts + same overlay sha256 → same composed infra.
$comment: License: CC0-1.0. Authored 2026-06-04 as part of Phase [H0.4] of the Repo→Solution-Play Converter masterplan. Companion to fai-manifest-v2.json provenance.policy_overlay (which points at the file applied at compose time) and to the future [V7.1] policy.schema.json (the V-engine consumer). Sections covered: regions, models, skus, naming, tags, network, rbac, identity, iac, encryption, observability, cost, custom_checks. v1.0.0 ships with FROZEN ENUMS — extending the enum requires a MAJOR bump and the [H0.27] schema-drift CI gate. Every section is OPTIONAL at the top level (an empty overlay {} validates) so customers can adopt incrementally; the only required top-level key is schema_version.

$schema.description: Optional URL of the schema this document validates against.

schema_version.description: Strict semver of THIS schema. v1.0.0 is the initial release. Bump the MAJOR when an existing enum value is removed or a previously-optional field becomes required.

name.description: Friendly identifier for the overlay (e.g. 'eu-finserv-baseline'). Surfaces in the [V7.19] PolicyDiff renderer.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this overlay enforces.

items.description: Cloud-agnostic region key. Azure: 'westeurope'; AWS: 'eu-west-1'; GCP: 'europe-west1'. The composer normalises across clouds.

regions.description: Allow-listed regions. Resolver candidates restricted to modules supporting these regions ([V7.6]).

models.description: Model allow/deny lists. When intent emits Cognitive Services / OpenAI / Bedrock, the composer forces deployments to allow[] ([V7.7]).

deny.description: Explicit deny-list. Takes precedence over allow[] when both match a literal.

skus.description: SKU allow/deny per resource family. Composer filters SKU params ([V7.8]).

naming.description: Resource-name overlay. Composer rewrites naming convention per these constraints ([V7.9]).

tags.description: Required tags + value patterns. Composer injects required[] on every resource + validates value patterns ([V7.10]).

required.description: Tag keys that MUST be present on every taggable resource.

additionalProperties.description: Regex (ECMAScript flavour) that the tag value MUST match. Example: '^(dev|staging|prod)$'.

values.description: Per-tag value-validation regex map. Keys must overlap with `required[]` or with tags freely set in IaC.

posture.description: public = open to internet; hybrid = mixed (some endpoints public, some private); private = no public endpoints, all traffic via private links.

vnet_required.description: Force every supported resource to be VNet-injected.

private_endpoint_required.description: Force private endpoints on every PaaS service that supports them.

dns_zone_overrides.description: Map of <service-key> → <fqdn-template> for private DNS zone overrides (e.g. 'storage' → 'privatelink.blob.core.windows.net').

managed_identity_required.description: If true, composer rejects service-principal credentials in favor of system/user-assigned managed identities.

role_assignment_policy.description: least-privilege = require minimum-scope built-in roles; built-in-only = no custom roles; custom-allowed = customer-defined roles permitted.

modular_emit.description: If true, composer emits one module per resource group; if false, single-file emit.

gold_allowed.description: If true, customer-curated 'gold' modules (outside AVM catalog) may be composed; if false, only AVM + AVM-promoted modules permitted.

cmk_required.description: Force customer-managed-key encryption on every supported resource.

key_vault_required.description: Force a Key Vault module in every composed template (target for CMK).

tls_min_version.description: Minimum TLS version on every supported endpoint.

log_analytics_required.description: Force a Log Analytics workspace + diagnostic settings on every supported resource.

app_insights_required.description: Force an Application Insights resource for every compute/app resource.

retention_days.description: Log Analytics retention. Azure max is 730 days for standard SKU.

band_target.description: Target monthly cost band. Composer rejects SKUs that push the aggregate above this band. Enum values are stable across `repo-facts.cost_band`.

tier_default.description: Default SKU tier per resource family when the resolver has multiple candidates.

currency.description: Currency for cost-band evaluation. Defaults to EUR if absent.

custom_checks.description: Customer-defined post-compose checks ([V7.18]). Each check is a named rule the policy engine runs against the composed AST.

kind.description: Built-in check kind. Custom-arbitrary code execution is OUT OF SCOPE for v1; v2 may add 'custom-script' kind via a sandboxed runtime.

severity.description: error = blocks the compose; warning = surfaces in PolicyDiff but allows compose; info = reported only in --verbose.

target.description: Resource type or module name the check applies to (e.g. 'Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts').

value.description: Expected value for property-equals / property-pattern (regex) / property-min / property-max kinds.
